subject: a tall stack of three thick, fluffy buttermilk pancakes heaped with golden toasted coconut flakes, cubes of ripe mango, a small dollop of whipped cream and a glossy drizzle of mango sauce, finished with mint
hero_ko: 토스트 코코넛 플레이크(황금색 컬) 듬뿍 + 망고 큐브 + 크림 + 망고 소스

geometry.silhouette: 3단 두툼 스택(약 2.5cm/장), 돔 윗면, 부푼 둥근 가장자리, 손으로 놓은 오프셋, 높이≈폭의 60%, 프레임 폭 65% 점유. 토핑은 전부 윗면에 얹힘(반죽에 박지 않음).
geometry.body: Three thick, tender pancakes stacked with a small, casual offset, as if placed by hand rather than aligned by a machine — the middle one shifted a little to the right, the top one a little back. Each pancake is a plump, pillowy round about 2.5 cm thick with a gently domed top and a soft rounded edge that bulges slightly outward where the batter rose in the pan; the stack is about 60% as tall as it is wide and occupies roughly 65% of the frame width, leaving generous empty background around it. The top face of each pancake is griddle-browned in a soft, blotchy, uneven gradient — warm caramel brown (#B9793F) at the centre where it sat longest on the hot pan, fading through toasty golden (#CF9455) into light golden (#D9A76B) toward the rim, with a few slightly darker freckles and one paler patch where a bubble lifted the batter, the way real pancakes never brown evenly. The side wall of every pancake is the pale cream of the risen crumb (#F1DDB0): a soft, spongy band with a fine open crumb texture, tiny irregular air pockets catching the light, meeting the browned top in a soft blurred edge rather than a hard line. A few tiny pinprick pores sit near the rim of the top pancake, barely visible. Where the pancakes touch, the top one presses very slightly into the one below, so the edges kiss softly instead of floating. The whole stack looks warm, tender and freshly flipped — the honest irregularity of a handmade bake.

toppings.label: WHIPPED CREAM
toppings.text: One modest dollop of lightly whipped cream (#FFF8EC), spoon-dropped, sits slightly off-centre toward the front-left of the top pancake — soft rounded peaks, a matte velvety surface, its lower edge relaxing into a soft skirt — mostly buried under the coconut and fruit rather than the star.

toppings.label: TOASTED COCONUT
toppings.text: A generous heap of toasted coconut flakes — the wide, thin shaved kind, not fine desiccated shreds — piled over the cream and across the top pancake: dozens of irregular curled chips of different sizes, toasted to a range of golden browns from pale gold (#E3C48C) through amber (#C9963F) to a few dark-edged pieces (#9A6A2E), each curled a different way with slightly darker crisp edges, tumbling loosely so some stand on edge, a few sliding off onto the browned rim and one or two caught on a side wall. They read as crisp, dry and fragrant.

toppings.label: MANGO
toppings.text: About six cubes of ripe mango (#F5A623), roughly 1.5 cm but cut a little unevenly and sitting at their own angles, piled against the coconut and the cream — glossy, juicy cut faces with a faint fibrous grain, one cube tipped on its side, one alone near the rim leaving a small wet mark.

toppings.label: MANGO SAUCE AND FINISHING
toppings.text: A thick, glossy mango sauce (#E8901A), a bright orange-yellow purée, drizzled over the fruit and coconut so it pools in glossy patches among the cubes and spills over the front edge in two slow drips of different lengths down the pale side walls, turning the crumb it touches a darker soaked gold. One small sprig of fresh mint with two leaves (#3E7A45) tucked against the cream, and a few tiny torn mint flecks over the mango. The toppings gather toward the front-left so the browned pancake surface stays visible on the opposite side, and the composition reads as one deliberate, appetizing arrangement — realistic portion size, no duplicate identical elements.

Soft studio softbox key light from the upper left with gentle warm ambient fill, a subtle rim of light along the top edges of the stack, and a faint, soft contact shadow directly beneath the stack only.
